author: Universal Pictures
description:
THIS SUMMER, THE TRUTH BELONGS TO EIGHT BILLION PEOPLE… So check out our Universal Below-the-Line Traineeship participants on Steven Spielberg's ‘Disclosure Day.' By offering trainees invaluable hands-on experience, this group of emerging talent contributed to key areas such as Costume, Sustainability, Production Accounting and on-set VFX. They gained essential skills while working alongside industry professionals on a major production.

We look forward to seeing the impact these talented individuals will have on the future of filmmaking. Go see 'Disclosure Day' in theaters this weekend!
title: Universal Below-The-Line Traineeship | Disclosure Day
